logical_payload.prompt:
Create one task-relevant technical illustration for a readable analytical report. The report body will be typeset separately. Do not add readable writing or numerals to the illustration.

Supporting illustration for the C assurance handover on WO-01 (water-pump module selection, water-reclamation transfer loop). A single figure inside the client's document: a correctly scaled bar chart of measured energy per module on the shared fixed-duty acceptance run - P2 12 kWh, P3 52, P1 56, P4 58 - drawn to one kWh scale so the 12-to-58 spread is visible, correcting the two delivered charts that misdraw it (A's near-equal bars, B's inverted lengths). Each bar carries its trusted-table quality index and defect count (Q97/d1, Q80/d3, Q84/d4, Q81/d0) and the recomputed gaps of 40, 44 and 46 kWh against the leader. A compact side panel lists the handover checklist: recompute eligibility and gaps from the trusted table; verify figure pixels against table values before publishing; keep P4's zero-defect record and P1's one-count margin as non-binding open questions; keep cost, delivery, maintenance and reliability explicitly unverified. The caption states that P2 is the client-correct policy winner and that no tag or target value appears in the figure.
